stem:
Inaya draws a straight path that starts at point $P$, passes through point $Q$, and continues forever only past $Q$.

Which two claims correctly name that path?

options.text: The path is a line segment $PQ$, because it stops at both $P$ and $Q$.
The path is a ray that starts at $P$ and goes through $Q$ forever.
The path has one endpoint at $P$ and no endpoint past $Q$.
The path is a full line, because any straight mark through $P$ and $Q$ must extend both ways forever.

teacher.key_rationale: A ray has one endpoint and extends forever in one direction: here from P through Q. Stopping at both ends names a segment and omits the forever side. Calling it a full line substitutes the wrong term.
